Living The Gourmet Bacon Salad
By: Lady Catherine ...
Published: Thursday, June 24, 2010 - 9:28am

Ingredients




Salad Ingredients:
6 slices of bacon

Preparation

1 Salad: 2 Combine all of the ingredients for the salad and mix well. 3 Dressing: 4 Heat bacon drippings in frying pan over medium heat.  Add garlic, then mayonnaise and vinegar; whisk until blended, 30-40 seconds. 5 Pour over salad and sprinkle bacon over.  Serve immediately.

About


You have just created a delightful summertime meal!
Lots and Lots of Love,
Catherine
